Key learnings from training: the 3-station rotating format with 1:30/1:00 intervals works well for beginners; separating gloves by discipline (karate touch vs kickboxing power) was effective; the favorite station is self-defense with pads plus simultaneous attack; a maximum of 2 rotations is practical; light sparring serves as closure; tracks should not be separated by person.

Aprendizajes clave: el formato de 3 estaciones rotativas 1:30/1:00 funciona bien para principiantes. Separar guantes por disciplina (karate toque vs kickboxing potencia) fue un acierto. La estación estrella es defensa personal con pads + ataque simultáneo. 2 rotaciones es el máximo práctico. El sparring ligero funciona como cierre. No separar tracks por persona.

The first training session took place on 2026-07-06 with participants Martín, Josefina, Martina, and Javi. It included a boxing/kickboxing circuit of 3 stations (hanging bag for touch, stacked tires for power, focus mitts for self-defense and attack) with a 1:30/1:00 format and 2 rotations, plus an improvised BJJ class where the group participated for the first time. Martín won in striking but lost quickly on the ground (2 losses).

Además, hubo una clase improvisada de BJJ donde el grupo participó por primera vez. Martín ganó en striking pero perdió rápido en el piso (2 derrotas). | When: 2026-07-06 | Involving: Martín, Josefina, Martina, Javi, profesor de BJJ (ex-karateka que conoce al sensei de Martín)
